public.title: Limited Invocation
public.description: A wrapped function sums its integer argument array. Invoke it for each array in calls, allowing only the first maximum calls to execute; later calls return null. maximum is 0 through 100. Return all results. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Count calls, including calls with empty argument arrays.

explanation: Only indices strictly below maximum execute the sum callback. O(total arguments) time and O(call count) output space. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
